product_launches.description: Sift launched its Fall '25 release, adding AI-driven fraud tools including pre-built workflow templates, policy abuse detection for incentive fraud, and enhanced investigations with Global Identity Search, an ATO Overview Dashboard, and Historical Chargeback Import.

press_references.value: Spike in first party fraud could presage raging storm of generative AI

product_launches.description: Sift has launched new large language model (LLM) features in its fraud and risk platform, including ActivityIQ for detecting ATO fraud, FIBR In-Console for benchmarking fraud KPIs, and automatic chargeback labeling to improve machine learning models.

press_references.value: Sift Brings Industry-First Fraud Benchmarking to Console with FIBR Integration to Strengthen Identity Trust

product_launches.description: Sift has integrated its Fraud Industry Benchmarking Resource (FIBR) into the Sift Console, allowing fraud and risk teams to access fraud performance metrics alongside industry benchmarks directly within the platform. This integration aims to enhance decision-making by providing comparative data on payment fraud, manual review, and chargeback rates.

overview_description.description:
Sift is helping people trust the internet and empowering online business across the world. Sift believes trust and safety are fundamental to every online interaction. As the pioneers of Digital Trust & Safety, we help more than 34,000 sites and apps navigate the fine balance between growing revenue and protecting their business. 

We prevent fraud with industry-leading technology and expertise, an unrivaled global data network, and a commitment to building long-term partnerships with its customers. 

Sift was founded in 2011 in San Francisco, California

product.name: Account Takeover (ATO) Protection
